questions.prompt: What does adding an expert persona to a system prompt reliably change?

options.text: The model's accuracy on factual questions
The style, focus, vocabulary, and tone of the answer

questions.explanation: Personas shape how an answer is written and what it emphasizes. A 2023 study of 162 personas found they didn't improve accuracy on factual questions.

questions.prompt: Which items belong in a system prompt? Select all that apply.

options.text: Safety limits that must hold every turn

questions.explanation: The system prompt holds standing instructions for the whole conversation. Each turn's specific request goes in the user message.

questions.prompt: "Explain X to me. Assume I am Y." is the format of the Audience ____ pattern.
questions.explanation: The Audience Persona pattern tells the model who the reader is, which controls depth, vocabulary, and examples.

questions.prompt: A user asks you to make the model write a speech 'as' a real, named politician. What's the best approach?

options.text: Do it and post it without labels
Use a fictional character inspired by an archetype and label any satire
Add 'This is real' to the output
Combine three real politicians into one persona

questions.explanation: Impersonating real people can deceive or defame. A fictional archetype keeps the creative value without putting words in a real person's mouth.

questions.prompt: Order the three ingredients of a scenario as the lesson lists them.
questions.explanation: A scenario sets the scene (setting), says who is on the other side (audience), and adds what makes it interesting (conflict).
